# Inner Hell Records

> Inner Hell Records is an independent extreme metal record label based in London, United Kingdom. The label specialises in black metal, industrial metal, and adjacent extreme music. Current roster: Vosforis. Debut release: Vosforis - Cosmic Cenotaph (IHR-VOS001), released 19 April 2024 on 180g heavyweight vinyl and digital.

Inner Hell Records ("IHR") is a small, artist-focused label. All releases are available on Bandcamp (vinyl and digital) and via the major streaming platforms. The label and artist roster also publish updates on Instagram and YouTube.

## About the label

- **Name:** Inner Hell Records (IHR)
- **Location:** London, United Kingdom
- **Address:** 128 City Road, London
- **Contact email:** innerhellrecords@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://innerhellrecords.co.uk/
- **Founded:** 2024 (first release)
- **Specialism:** Extreme metal - black metal, industrial metal, cosmic / philosophical themes
- **Distribution model:** Direct-to-fan vinyl (Bandcamp) + streaming aggregation via Hyperfollow / DistroKid

## Roster

### Vosforis

- **Genre:** Extreme metal / black metal / industrial metal
- **Origin:** London, United Kingdom
- **Formed:** 2022
- **Members:**
  - Simon White - composition, guitars, vocals
  - Adrian Erlandsson - drums
- **Artist page:** https://innerhellrecords.co.uk/artist.html
- **Bandcamp:** https://vosforis.bandcamp.com/
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/vosforisofficial/

## Releases

### Vosforis - Cosmic Cenotaph

- **Catalogue:** IHR-VOS001
- **Artist:** Vosforis
- **Label:** Inner Hell Records
- **Release date:** 19 April 2024
- **Format:** 12-inch LP (180g heavyweight vinyl) and digital
- **Track count:** 11
- **Approximate length:** 50 minutes
- **Themes:** Mortality, scale, the indifference of the void, cosmic dread
- **Buy vinyl / digital:** https://vosforis.bandcamp.com/album/cosmic-cenotaph
- **Streaming (all platforms):** https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/vosforis/cosmic-cenotaph
- **Lyric video (Decoherence):** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hMjrpQq2tEE
